address: Caferağa Mahallesi, Ressam Şeref Akdik Sokak No:10, Kadıköy, Istanbul, 34710, Türkiye
bio: Press the buzzer and enter this animated three-storey establishment where the effervescent spirit of the bohemian Moda neighbourhood truly comes to life. As the name suggests, this restaurant serves up a taste of Italy. The dishes are not unnecessarily complicated, but they have that je-ne-sais-quoi that makes Mediterranean cuisine so beloved. The menu features options such as beef cheeks braised in red wine and served with truffle purée or pappardelle with rabbit ragù. And let's be honest: who can resist a good old classic like tiramisu to cap it all off?
